stem:
Manav plants a vertical stick on the playground and marks the tip of its shadow through two school days. His teacher asks how to measure one day of nearly 24 hours from these marks.

Which method is correct?

options.text: Find the time from the longest shadow on day 1 to the longest shadow on day 2.
Find the time from the shortest shadow on day 1 to the shortest shadow on day 2.
Double the time from sunrise to sunset on a single day.
Count how many shadow marks he made between morning and evening on one day.

teacher.key_rationale: Shortest shadow marks the Sun highest. That event to the next is nearly one day.
